'''Stage II Dispatchers''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier.

Killing one will grant the {{AdvancementLink|TETH Suppression}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned after a [[Stage I Dispatcher]] evolves.
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Stage III Dispatcher]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Stage II Dispatchers are Stationary Offensive Support Parasites.
*Stage II Dispatchers can store and teleport parasites around using [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]], Stage II Dispatchers can summon up to 6. Parasites that have been stored by a Dispatcher that despawn will end up back in the Dispatcher's storage.
**[[Buglin|Buglins]] stored by Stage II Dispatchers will become [[Rupter|Rupters]].
**[[Incomplete Forms]] stored by a Stage II Dispatcher reaching 6 value (with [[Small Incomplete Form|Small]] having a value of 1 and [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium]] having a value of 2) will create a [[Heed]].
*Stage II Dispatchers can summon up to 5 [[Seizer|Seizers]].
*Stage II Dispatchers will force nearby [[Assimilated Mobs]] to drop their disguise (unless if they are on water).
*Stage II Dispatchers throw 4 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. The bombs inflict 7 damage each and place an effect cloud of stacking [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage II Dispatchers can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 5.5, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.
*Stage II Dispatchers will apply the following effects to parasites:
**Speed I (3:20)
**Regeneration II (3:20)
**[[Debar]] I (3:20)
**[[Link]] I (5:00)
**[[Heightened Senses]] II (3:20)
*Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] is present in the dimension, Stage II Dispatchers will become [[Stage I Dispatcher|Stage I Dispatchers]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Stage II Dispatchers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
**Any entities a Dispatcher summons will also be on fire. (Note that fire is not enough to outright kill their tentacles)

* Right clicking on any of their Dispatcher Tentacles or Seizers will apply the glowing effect to their Dispatcher.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Stage II Dispatchers do not despawn.
* Stage II Dispatchers are also known as '''DodSII''' in the Mod Files.
* In the early builds of [[Version 1.9.6|1.9.6]], Dispatchers used to be called ‘’’Reinforcers’’’.
